paragraphs: Software engineer who builds AI-backed products end to end: APIs, integrations, deployment, and the user workflow around them. M.S. in Robotics & Autonomous Systems (AI), Arizona State University.
Previously built the APIs and staff interface for a blood-bank management system live in 3 hospitals, and trained the staff who used it.
features: A native menu-bar app for finding things you copied earlier without keeping secrets around. I built the clipboard monitor, a retention worker (24 hours by default), SHA-256 deduplication and natural-language search.

Engineering detail: passwords, tokens, keys and OTPs are filtered before anything is saved. Search combines intent parsing, keywords and on-device embeddings. On a 40-query set, top-1 accuracy rose from 70% to roughly…
Verification: 302 core checks and 35 headless end-to-end tests. Cloud AI is off by default.
Swift, SwiftUI, on-device LLM and embeddings, OCR · Demo and download
A deployed FastAPI service combining tool calling with retrieval over user-uploaded documents. I built auth, conversation persistence, per-user rate limits and the browser client.
